_doc: Training ring in the lighthouse (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md, area 'Fortschritt, XP und Training'). Read by scripts/core/TrainingGround.gd. dummies: carved stand-ins, a Spirling kind under a wooden name at the team's top ring plus ring_offset (at least 2). Bouts are friendly: no coins, nothing lost, the team is rested afterwards. growth_mult: growth of a bout against wild-battle growth. goals: met once each, by wins in total or against one dummy; the reward lands in the satchel.

goals.text: Beat the Oak Dummy three times.
